application-for-tax-clearance-certificat.description:
Requirements:
Have a TIN and be a registered taxpayer.
Have no outstanding tax arrears with RRA. If arrears exist, RRA will display them before the application can be submitted.
Hebuza shall apply the requested  service through online through the RRA E-Tax system.
Pay the application fee of RWF 5,000 to RRA, immediately after submitting the application.
After payment, the TCC is automatically generated and can be downloaded from the taxpayer portal. RRA currently indicates that the process takes about one day when the taxpayer is compliant. the service charged by Hebuza for the service offered is Frw 2,000Frw
application-for-tax-clearance-certificat.description_rw:
Ibisabwa:

Kuba ufite TIN kandi uri umusoreshwa wanditswe.
Kuba nta mwenda w’imisoro ufitiye RRA. Niba hari umwenda, RRA izawugaragaza mbere y’uko ubusabe bushyikirizwa.
Hebuza izasaba serivisi isabwa hifashishijwe uburyo bwo kuri internet bwa RRA E-Tax.
Kwishyura 5,000 Frw yishyurwa RRA, ako kanya nyuma yo gutanga ubusabe.
Nyuma yo kwishyura, TCC ihita ikorwa mu buryo bwikora kandi ishobora gukurwa kuri portal y’umusoreshwa. RRA ivuga ko iyo umusoreshwa yujuje ibisabwa, iki gikorwa gifata hafi umunsi umwe.
Amafaranga ya serivisi ya Hebuza kuri serivisi itanzwe ni 2,000 Frw.
application-for-tax-clearance-certificat.description_en:
Requirements:
Have a TIN and be a registered taxpayer.
Have no outstanding tax arrears with RRA. If arrears exist, RRA will display them before the application can be submitted.
Hebuza shall apply the requested  service through online through the RRA E-Tax system.
Pay the application fee of RWF 5,000 to RRA, immediately after submitting the application.
After payment, the TCC is automatically generated and can be downloaded from the taxpayer portal. RRA currently indicates that the process takes about one day when the taxpayer is compliant. the service charged by Hebuza for the service offered is Frw 2,000Frw
application-for-tax-clearance-certificat.description_fr:
Exigences :

Avoir un NIF (TIN) et être un contribuable enregistré.
N’avoir aucun arriéré fiscal auprès de la RRA. Si des arriérés existent, la RRA les affichera avant que la demande puisse être soumise.
Hebuza introduira la demande du service requis en ligne via le système RRA E-Tax.
Payer les frais de demande de 5 000 Frw à la RRA, immédiatement après avoir soumis la demande.
Après le paiement, le TCC est généré automatiquement et peut être téléchargé depuis le portail du contribuable. La RRA indique actuellement que la procédure prend environ un jour lorsque le contribuable est en règle.
Les frais de service de Hebuza pour le service offert sont de 2 000 Frw.

company-registration.description:
For RDB company registration in Rwanda, the requirements depend on the type of company. 

Requirements for a Domestic Company
Active email address
National ID or Passport of the applicant/shareholders
Proposed company name — the name must be approved before incorporation
Provisional business activities
Registered company address
Shareholders’ particulars
Directors’ particulars
Board members’ particulars, where applicable
Memorandum and Articles of Association, where applicable

RDB states that company registration is 100% online and free of charge. The registration process combines incorporation with obtaining the company code, which also serves as the TIN and social security registration number. Hebuza charges 20,000Frw as service charges.
company-registration.description_rw:
Mu kwiyandikisha kw’ikigo muri RDB mu Rwanda, ibisabwa biterwa n’ubwoko bw’ikigo.

Ibisabwa ku kigo cy’imbere mu gihugu:

Aderesi ya e-mail ikora
Indangamuntu cyangwa pasiporo by’usaba/abanyamigabane
Izina ry’ikigo rishaka gukoreshwa — izina rigomba kubanza kwemezwa mbere yo gushinga ikigo
Ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi biteganyijwe
Aderesi yemewe y’ikigo
Amakuru y’abanyamigabane
Amakuru y’abayobozi b’ikigo
Amakuru y’abagize inama y’ubuyobozi, aho bikenewe
Amasezerano shingiro n’amategeko ngengamikorere y’ikigo, aho bikenewe

RDB ivuga ko kwiyandikisha kw’ikigo bikorwa 100% kuri murandasi kandi ku buntu. Igikorwa cyo kwiyandikisha gikubiyemo gushinga ikigo no kubona company code, ikora kandi nka TIN ndetse ikaba ari nimero yo kwiyandikisha muri gahunda y’ubwiteganyirize bw’abakozi.

Hebuza yishyuza 20,000 Frw nk’amafaranga ya serivisi.

company-registration.description_fr:
our l’enregistrement d’une entreprise auprès de la RDB au Rwanda, les exigences dépendent du type d’entreprise.

Exigences pour une entreprise nationale :

Adresse e-mail active
Carte d’identité nationale ou passeport du demandeur/des actionnaires
Nom proposé pour l’entreprise — le nom doit être approuvé avant la constitution
Activités commerciales prévues
Adresse officielle de l’entreprise
Informations sur les actionnaires
Informations sur les administrateurs
Informations sur les membres du conseil d’administration, le cas échéant
Acte constitutif et statuts, le cas échéant

La RDB indique que l’enregistrement d’une entreprise se fait 100 % en ligne et gratuitement. Le processus d’enregistrement comprend la constitution de l’entreprise ainsi que l’obtention du code de l’entreprise, qui sert également de NIF (TIN) et de numéro d’enregistrement à la sécurité sociale.

Hebuza facture 20 000 Frw de frais de service.

grant-application-support.description:
Grant Opportunity & Eligibility Assessment – Identify suitable grants and assess eligibility requirements.
Proposal & Business Plan Preparation – Develop compelling grant proposals, business plans, and project concepts.
Budget & Financial Projections – Prepare project budgets, financial projections, and required financial documents.
Application & Documentation Support – Complete application forms, organize supporting documents, and assist with online submission.
Follow-Up & Interview Support – Prepare for interviews/pitches, respond to funder queries, and support post-submission follow-up.
grant-application-support.description_rw:
Kumenya amahirwe y’inkunga no gusuzuma ibisabwa – Kumenya inkunga zibereye umushinga no gusuzuma niba wujuje ibisabwa.
Gutegura umushinga w’ubusabe n’igenamigambi ry’ubucuruzi – Gutegura inyandiko zisobanutse kandi zishimishije zisaba inkunga, business plan, n’ibitekerezo by’umushinga.
Gutegura ingengo y’imari n’imibare y’imari iteganyijwe – Gutegura ingengo y’imari y’umushinga, imibare y’imari iteganyijwe n’inyandiko z’imari zisabwa.
Gufasha mu busabe no gutegura inyandiko – Kuzuza impapuro zisaba inkunga, gutunganya inyandiko ziherekeza ubusabe no gufasha mu kohereza ubusabe hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga.
Gukurikirana ubusabe no kwitegura ikiganiro – Gufasha kwitegura ibiganiro cyangwa kwerekana umushinga, gusubiza ibibazo by’abatanga inkunga no gukurikirana ubusabe nyuma yo kubwohereza.
grant-application-support.description_en:
Grant Opportunity & Eligibility Assessment – Identify suitable grants and assess eligibility requirements.
Proposal & Business Plan Preparation – Develop compelling grant proposals, business plans, and project concepts.
Budget & Financial Projections – Prepare project budgets, financial projections, and required financial documents.
Application & Documentation Support – Complete application forms, organize supporting documents, and assist with online submission.
Follow-Up & Interview Support – Prepare for interviews/pitches, respond to funder queries, and support post-submission follow-up.
grant-application-support.description_fr:
Identification des opportunités de subvention et évaluation de l’éligibilité – Identifier les subventions adaptées et évaluer les critères d’éligibilité.
Préparation de la proposition et du plan d’affaires – Élaborer des propositions de subvention convaincantes, des plans d’affaires et des concepts de projets.

Assistance à la demande et à la documentation – Remplir les formulaires de demande, organiser les pièces justificatives et assister à la soumission en ligne.
Suivi et préparation aux entretiens – Préparer les entretiens et présentations, répondre aux demandes des bailleurs de fonds et assurer le suivi après la soumission.

SERVICES
INCLUDED

·       
Tax
& Regulatory Compliance Guidance

Basic guidance and reminders on tax declarations, payment deadlines, RRA/RDB
compliance and other important business obligations.

·

Administration Support

Guidance on routine business administration, official correspondence,

·

monthly-business-support-advisory-subscr.description_rw:
SERIVISI ZIKUBIYEMO
Ubujyanama ku kubahiriza imisoro n’amabwiriza

Ubufasha bw’ibanze no kwibutsa ku bijyanye no gutanga imenyekanisha ry’imisoro, igihe ntarengwa cyo kwishyura, kubahiriza ibisabwa na RRA/RDB n’izindi nshingano z’ingenzi z’ikigo.

Ubufasha mu micungire y’ubucuruzi

Ubufasha mu mirimo isanzwe y’ubuyobozi bw’ikigo, inyandiko n’amabaruwa yoherezwa mu nzego zitandukanye, gusaba serivisi z’ubuyobozi ndetse no gutegura inyandiko z’ibanze z’ubucuruzi.

Ubujyanama mu kwamamaza no kongera abakiriya

Inama zifatika ku bijyanye no kwamamaza, gushaka no kongera abakiriya, promotion, imbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse n’ingamba zo kongera ibicuruzwa n’inyungu.

Isuzuma ry’amasezerano n’inyandiko z’ubucuruzi

Gusuzuma amasezerano, ubwumvikane n’izindi nyandiko z’ubucuruzi kugira ngo hamenyekane ingingo z’ingenzi n’ibibazo bishobora kuvuka mbere yo kuzisinya cyangwa kuzikoresha.

Ubujyanama mu micungire y’imari n’amafaranga y’ikigo

Inama zifatika ku micungire y’amafaranga yinjira n’asohoka, amafaranga akoreshwa, igenamigambi ry’imari, gukurikirana no kwishyuza imyenda y’abakiriya ndetse n’ibyemezo by’imari bya buri munsi.

Isuzuma ry’amafaranga akoreshwa n’inyungu

Gusuzuma amafaranga y’ingenzi ikigo gikoresha n’ibibazo bishobora kuba bituma inyungu iba nke, no gutanga ingamba zifatika zo kugabanya amafaranga akoreshwa bitari ngombwa.

outsourcing-marketing-staff-month.description:
Outsourced Marketing Staff/Month: Provision of marketing staff by an external company or agency on a monthly, weekly, or daily basis, depending on the client’s needs.

Note: Monthly charges cover the staff service only. Expenses such as transportation, mission allowances, clothing/uniforms, promotional materials, and other staff-related costs are not included and are charged separately.
outsourcing-marketing-staff-month.description_rw:
Abakozi ba Marketing bakodeshwa / ukwezi: Gutanga abakozi ba marketing binyuze mu kigo cyangwa agenti byo hanze, ku buryo bwa buri kwezi, buri cyumweru, cyangwa buri munsi, bitewe n’ibyo umukiriya akeneye.

Icyitonderwa: Amafaranga yishyurwa akubiyemo serivisi z’abakozi gusa. Ibindi byose bishobora gukenerwa n’abakozi, birimo transport, amafaranga y’ingendo (mission allowances), imyambaro/uniform, ibikoresho byo kwamamaza, n’ibindi, ntibibarwa muri ayo mafaranga kandi byishyurwa ukwabyo.
